blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. The journey from Cusco to Puno is by bus and takes almost the whole day.

There are several stops along the way.

You will visit **Andahuaylillas**, which is compared to the Sistine Chapel.

Next is **Raqchi**, an ancient complex that served administrative functions during the Inca period.

After lunch in **Sicuani**, continue to **La Raya**. Here, a market stands against a backdrop of mountains at one of the highest points on the road.

Another stop is **Pucará**, an ancient Inca fortification.

After approximately **10 hours on the road**, arrive in Puno and check into **Sol Plaza 3*** or a similar hotel.

blocks.text:
Instead of travelling by bus, you can take the luxury **Titicaca Train** from Cusco to Puno.

It runs on **Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays**. Mountain scenery gradually changes outside your window during the journey.

Lunch in the dining car includes a starter, a main course and dessert. Wine can be ordered at the bar.

The route includes a stop at **La Raya**, at **4319 metres**, the highest point of the journey.

Arrival in Puno is around **19:00**.

**Supplement:** $250 per person.
